pages.text:
# SKY13453-385LF

Synthetic fixture page, revision B. SPDT switch for 0.1 to 6.0 GHz applications.

## Features
- Broadband frequency range: 0.1 to 6.0 GHz
- Low insertion loss
- High isolation
- Positive control logic, 1.8 V compatible

## Electrical Specifications

| Parameter | Condition | Min | Typ | Max | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insertion loss | 2.4 GHz | | 0.45 | 0.60 | dB |
| Isolation | 2.4 GHz | 23 | 26 | | dB |
| Supply voltage VDD | | 1.65 | 2.8 | 3.6 | V |
| Switching time | | | 200 | | ns |

## Package Dimensions

QFN-12, 2.0 x 2.0 x 0.75 mm. Moisture sensitivity level MSL1.
